Wi-Fi: connect this device and the computer to the same local network, then scan the QR code shown by TabLink on the computer.\n\nUSB: connect a data cable, turn on USB tethering in Android settings, then scan the USB network QR code. USB debugging is not required.

Stable updates
Check / Continue stable update

TabLink retrieves update manifests from the personal blog and GitHub and verifies their signatures. It also verifies the package size and SHA-256. Automatic updates open Android system installation confirmation while the secondary display is idle. Download automatically prepares the package and waits for you to install it. Never update makes no update network requests. Android still requires confirmation in the system installer.
